title: NavySimulator MIOs
description: Military industrial organizations that can be assigned to ships, written by NavySimulator import-mios with their include resolved (S-MIO). Bonus keys are the game's.

tokens.description: Equipment types (capital_ship), archetypes (ship_hull_heavy), hulls or equipment groups (mio_cat_eq_all_battleship).

id.description: The trait token; empty for an initial trait.

x.description: Column in the tree grid (relative positions resolved).

parents.description: parent, any_parent and all_parents: every requirement must be met (S-MIO-TREE).

needed.description: num_parents_needed; 1 for any_parent, all for all_parents.

organizationModifiers.description: Modifiers of the MIO itself; no effect in battle.

conditions.description: visible/available triggers as script text (not checked).

countries.description: Tags named in its allowed trigger (outside NOT).

excludedCountries.description: Tags its allowed trigger names inside a NOT: the MIO is for every other country.

archetypeOnly.description: allowed = { always = no }: only included by other MIOs.

debugOnly.description: allowed = { is_debug = yes }: only in the game's debug mode.

include.description: The MIO it was built from.

equipmentTypes.description: equipment_type: the designs it can be assigned to (S-MIO-MATCH).
